ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 82% high-intensity white pixels to 18% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring jagged peaks and steep valleys with greater frequency observed toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five parallel, horizontal dark linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the upper right lobe. Faint, unaligned linear marks are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of high-contrast white calcified masses at the lateral tips of both fluke lobes and distinct parallel rake marks on the right lobe surface.
